name: MCV1 coverage
definition: Percentage of surviving infants who received the first dose of measles-containing vaccine
numerator: Number of MCV1 doses given (DE.09 = MCV1)
source: JRF 2016 4A. Routine Coverage row 4160; Instructions row 54 (MCV includes M MR MMR MMRV)

name: MCV2 coverage
definition: Percentage of the national MCV2 target population who received the second dose of measles-containing vaccine
numerator: Number of MCV2 doses given (DE.09 = MCV2)
denominator: Target population for MCV2 as the country defines it

name: Districts by MCV1 coverage band
definition: Number of districts with MCV1 coverage in each band
numerator: Districts in each band of IND.01: <50% / 50–79% / 80–89% / 90–94% / ≥95%

name: Districts by MCV2 coverage band
definition: Number of districts with MCV2 coverage in each band
numerator: Districts in each band of IND.02: <50% / 50–79% / 80–89% / 90–94% / ≥95%

name: Late MCV1 doses
definition: Number of MCV1 doses given after the scheduled age (12–23 months where MCV1 is scheduled before 12 months; later than the national definition where it is scheduled at 12 months or later)

name: MCV1–MCV2 dropout
definition: Percentage of children who received MCV1 but not MCV2
source: Derived from IND.01 and IND.02; the facility analysis guide (referenced; licence withheld) defines dropout between doses

name: Confirmed measles cases
source: JRF 2016 1. Reported Cases row 1020; Instructions row 10
